title: one bad declaration must not lose the other forty
note: One bad declaration among forty-one must not cost the other forty. It does not: all 41 elements survive and exactly one error is reported, naming the offending keyword. OBSERVATION, pre-existing: recovery re-homes every declaration AFTER the fault to the root namespace instead of leaving them inside `package Big`, which is why the surviving roots are listed here. Nothing is lost, but the containment is wrong — recorded so it is known rather than hidden.
